sql_reading_A.sql:
SELECT
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
    AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment,
    VAR_POP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS variance_max_enrollment,
    AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - VAR_POP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS difference
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

sql_reading_B.sql:
SELECT
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
    AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment,
    VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS variance_max_enrollment,
    AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS difference
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

question_text: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and also show the difference between the average and the variance for each category. Do not return any rounded answers.
